The app keeps the session and the video when the screen goes off or another app is opened.

## Changes
- A server that does not answer no longer signs you out. After a long lock the
  network or the tunnel may not be up yet: the app waits and signs in again by
  itself as soon as the server answers. The password is asked only when the
  server refuses the saved credentials.
- The screen stays on while live or recorded video plays. A paused recording,
  a stalled stream or a screen without video lets it go off as usual.
- History continues where it stopped after the screen goes off or another app
  is opened, also when the session was renewed in the meantime.
- In the background the app asks the server nothing: the review list is
  refreshed when you come back, and old camera activity is not shown as current.

## Install
Download the APK below. To update an installed build use `adb install -r`;
do not uninstall the app, that erases the session and the saved credentials.

Requires Android 12 (API 31) or newer, arm64-v8a or armeabi-v7a.
